opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK office (deadline 15 September 2026)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds; open to any field including arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, sport.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across a wide range of fields, supporting events, exchanges, collaborative outputs, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health (deadline 1 December 2026)

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; open to researchers, practitioners, managers, carers, policy makers and voluntary sector workers in health and medicine who can demonstrate UK‑Japan partnership; preference for early‑career applicants and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 per year (max £30,000 total) to support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan, covering travel, conference, and publication costs.
